Today, we have updates on the November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast and the Marvel Doomsday ticket opening date in India.

## November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast
Cyclone Akvan is approaching the Indian coast and is expected to intensify tomorrow, November 18. The India Meteorological Department, or IMD, has issued heavy rainfall warnings across several states. An orange alert has been issued for Chennai, Tiruvallur, and Chengalpattu for November 18 and 19, with heavy rain likely in Chennai and neighboring districts as the cyclonic storm approaches the Andhra coast.

## Marvel Doomsday Ticket Opening Date in India
Advance ticket sales for "Avengers: Doomsday" are set to begin in India today, November 17.
